title: The Last Oath
author: Tamsin Montrose
blurb: Ulyana Kavanagh, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
